changelog: Library now has a Sort by control and grid/list toggle below the filter chips.
The Library search icon now searches inside your library instead of opening global search.
Pure black theme is no longer enabled by default.
Added Last.fm scrobbling with now-playing updates on track change and scrobbles after a qualifying listen.
Smart mixes moved to the Library + sheet with selectable mood and artist pills.
Lossless server name now suggests "FLAC / AAC Server".
